name: riven-postban-frames2
description: Riven after the bans, frame test 2. The first test (lab/results/20261113-222247-riven-postban-frames.json) gave the same games for every set of battlefields: the engine asks the pilot which of its three battlefields to play (game_engine.cpp, battlefield setup) and the lab's pilots always answer the first one listed, so only the first battlefield of a list is ever played. Here the same main deck for each champion with six different battlefields listed first, cheap pilot, 400 games per opponent on the same seeds.
